title: Fix Section Vo Beat Timing
summary: Section hosts in full heating/cooling videos reuse one Scene across beats without begin_vo_beat, so hold_for spent budgets leak across beats that share clause keys (intro/outro/label) and later beats collapse to min_wait (~0.3s).
closed_summary: Section hosts now call begin_vo_beat(host, beat_cls.__name__) before each construct so hold_for spent budgets reset per beat. load_vo_timing merges manifests so multi-module imports keep all beat timings. Re-render full Heating/Cooling HQ videos for the fix to appear in the mp4s.
